You receive the text with headings and a suggested title, ready to paste into your site or send to your editor.

faq: Will the posts be flagged as AI text?

We do not try to hide how we work. A person edits each draft, adds your own examples and removes filler. We write for readers first. You decide whether to disclose AI assistance, as some platforms ask.
We flag every number, name and claim in the draft and check them against sources you give us and public pages. You approve the final text. We never invent quotes, studies or customer stories.
Can you match my current blog voice?
Yes. Send two or three posts you like and we match the tone, length and style. Standard includes one round of tone matching, and Premium adds a short style sheet for future writers.
Basic and Standard are delivered as text. Premium adds uploading to your site as unpublished posts, so you only press publish. We need editor access to do this, never your password.
